title: Skin Runtime Registry, Selection Resolver & Legacy Adapter Foundation
objective: Implement the first production UISK runtime seam: a registry-backed Skin Pack identity/catalog, deterministic assignment precedence resolver, Roses legacy alias resolution, safe application/clear helpers, Ember/Chromatic compatibility, and a governed validation profile without yet implementing material/frame/effect engines or additional production skin assets.

scope.purpose: Create the runtime foundation that later UISR tranches can build on while preserving the live Ember/Chromatic experience and all application authority boundaries.
included: canonical registry identities for Ember/Chromatic plus the eighteen target Skin Packs
runtime availability metadata distinguishing live migration packs from design-complete not-yet-implemented packs
exact alias resolution including talker-theme to roses-theme
follow-context versus always-use-personal assignment precedence resolver
safe presentation-only apply and clear helpers
App migration to common clear/apply transport without adding a new gallery yet
excluded: new production Skin Pack visual assets
gameplay, permission, hidden-information or routing authority changes
scope.completion_gate: The shared UI package exposes a registry-backed Skin Pack runtime foundation with deterministic selection/fallback semantics and legacy Ember/Chromatic compatibility; the real App uses the compatibility-safe transport; exact-head validation passes on Linux and Windows; publication is durable; and control-plane closeout selects UISR-02 while preserving MCS-15 as the terminal program resume target.

selection_boundaries: Owner explicitly redirected product-development to UISR implementation after UISK-16 design closeout.
MCS-15 was selected_not_started and had no implementation branch or authority when deferred.
UISR-01 is presentation infrastructure only and creates no gameplay, permission, hidden-information, campaign, world or rules authority.
Only Ember and Chromatic become activatable in UISR-01; the eighteen target packs may be registered as known design identities but remain unavailable until their implementation tranches.
Roses Theme is canonical; talker-theme is an exact compatibility alias only.
After UISR-10 terminal closeout, product selection returns to preserved MCS-15 unless the owner explicitly changes priority.

implementation_plan.red: write focused UISR-01 tests first in candidate
implementation_plan.green: implement registry/resolver/legacy adapter and App transport migration
implementation_plan.proof: run UISR-01 validation profile on exact candidate across Linux and Windows
implementation_plan.closeout: publish exact validated app head, reconcile AIOC checkpoint, select UISR-02

next_action: Implement UISR-01 on feature/uisr-01-skin-runtime-foundation, open PR, obtain exact-head validation, publish under OPS3 lease, then close out to UISR-02.
